summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a capital increase at its subsidiary, CJSC Belarusian Telecommunications Network (BeST). BeST's capital was increased by BYN 10,876,568.78 from BYN 1,363,865,668.50 to BYN 1,374,742,237.28. Turkcell fully paid its pre-emption rights in the increase. This is a routine capital infusion into a subsidiary, not a special situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private. No board recommendation or advisors were named. There are no deal terms typical of mergers or tender offers. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report.
